title: Hybridization with a lone pair
hints: Compare the result with each choice and check its sign, units, or underlying rule.
solution: Three N–H bonds and one lone pair give four domains, so N is $sp^3$.
statement:
What hybrid label applies to the N in $\ce{NH3}$ in the localized model?

[_]{a}

explanations: The lone pair occupies one domain.
Counting only the three bond directions would omit the lone pair.
This is the five-domain course label.
